items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Milt Ebbins was the manager of Basie's band... Then Milt Ebbins got on the phone and he says, 'Basie's not here... I said, 'Well, make 'Cottage for Sale' for me... So he made it.'

ctx.x: Milt Ebbins was the manager of Basie's band. He was an ex-trumpet player. He had a band like Vaughn Monroe and what have you. He was from the New England states. And it was a gag, going to make a song for poor Jo, GI Jo, and by that time Lester came in - we couldn't get him at Fort Ord but we got him out of the Army some way. Then I went to Los Angeles and I went out to some little hideaway place with Lester and we played. I said, "Don't worry about it, Pres, everything's going to be all right." Norman Granz…
